sources.title: Vehicle Titles — Idaho Transportation Department (DMV)
sources.authorityNotes: Official ITD DMV page, raw HTML cached via fetch-source.mjs. Written for vehicles; it does not mention manufactured homes anywhere (searched). ITD's site search returned no manufactured-home titling page. Used for manufactured homes only because Idaho Code 49-501(2)(b) applies the vehicle title chapter's titling requirements to them; claims citing it are MEDIUM confidence for that reason. County fee table includes implementation dates; Ada's row shows September 1, 2023.
sources.stalenessRisk: HIGH — fee amounts, penalties and county admin fees change; the table already shows a county change dated November 19, 2026. Re-check before publishing any dollar figure.
